conclusion: A bounded operator result may remain accepted while a stronger packaging requirement fails, but the unmet requirement must remain explicit. Evidence-validation success classifies the boundary; it cannot convert a failed installation into a passing one.
decision: Keep EV-0064 immutable and accept only its isolated ordinary-Python dual-launch result. Use EV-0065 to bind the committed children/root and permanently classify schema 6 and 7 as NON-PASSING, with the final-v6 reservation unsatisfied. Do not reuse either partial prefix. In CP-0029, apply only the queue-mock test fix, prove serial and concurrent stability, update locks, and build a fresh schema-8 prefix before expanding the model operator matrix.
invalidated_assumptions: EV-0065 exit code zero means the repository-local install or postinstall Triton route passed.
A partially built schema-6 or schema-7 prefix may be resumed and promoted after a later fix.
The schema-7 queue-test failure invalidates the separately frozen ordinary-Python execution evidence.
Diagnosing a test-harness race is equivalent to producing a passing installation.
observation: The schema-6 install was interrupted after DEFAULT_ROCM_PATH=/opt/rocm contamination was found, and the fresh schema-7 install exited 8 on one pre-ACK queue mock test. Neither prefix has a manifest or activation script. EV-0065 recursively validates EV-0064 and the committed source identities, but explicitly records repository_local_install_accepted=false, postinstall OpenCL/Triton=false, and a fresh schema-8 install deferred to CP-0029.
question_or_symptom: How should acceptance be recorded when the normal Triton operator path passes but the reserved final repository-local install does not?
